[[Basketball Champions League|Champions League]] | height_m = 2.10 | weight_kg = 95 | birth_date = {{birth date and age|df=yes|2000|1|9}} | birth_place = [[Zagreb]], Croatia | nationality = Croatian | team = Petrol Olimpija | number = 9 | college = | draft = | draft_year = | draft_team = | career_start = 2017 | career_end = | years1 = 2017–2018 | team1 = [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet B|FC Barcelona B]] | years2 = 2018–present | team2 = [[KK Olimpija|Petrol Olimpija]] | highlights = *{{nowrap|[[FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship#Division B|FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship B]] MVP (2017)}} | medaltemplates = {{MedalSport|Men's [[basketball]]}} {{MedalCountry|{{bk|CRO}}}} {{MedalCompetition|[[FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship|FIBA Europe U18 Championship B]]}} {{MedalGold|2017 Estonia|[[Croatia men's national basketball team|National team]]}} }} '''Luka Šamanić''' (born 9 January 2000) is a Croatian professional [[basketball]] player for [[KK Olimpija|Petrol Olimpija]] of the [[Premier A Slovenian Basketball League|Slovenian League]] and [[ABA League]]. A [[power forward (basketball)|power forward]], he is widely considered one of the top European prospects for the [[2019 NBA draft]].{{cite web |last1=Beer |first1=Tommy |title=An Early 2019 NBA Mock Draft: Duke's Barrett And Reddish On Track To Go 1-2 |url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/tommybeer/2018/09/12/early-2019-nba-mock-draft/#6cb734f819eb |website=[[Forbes]] |accessdate=21 September 2018 |date=12 September 2018}}{{cite web |last1=Givony |first1=Jonathan |title=NBA draft scouting: 10 international prospects for 2019 and beyond |url=http://www.espn.com/nba/insider/story/_/id/24324900/nba-draft-scouting-luka-samanic-fiba-u18-european-championships |publisher=[[ESPN]] |accessdate=21 September 2018 |date=9 August 2018}} A native of [[Zagreb]], Šamanić started his youth career with Croatian club [[KK Zagreb|Zagreb]]. In 2016, he moved to [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|FC Barcelona]] in Spain, where he joined the [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet B|reserve team]] in the Spanish [[LEB Oro|second-tier league]]. Šamanić has represented [[Croatia men's national basketball team|Croatia]] multiple times in [[FIBA]] events, leading his team to a [[gold medal]] at the [[FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship#Division B|FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship Division B]] in 2017, while earning [[most valuable player]] honors. == Early life == Šamanić was born in [[Zagreb]], Croatia.{{cite web |last1=Gaibotti |first1=Federico |title=Luka Samanic, scouting report about the rising Croatian prospect |url=https://www.basketuniverso.it/luka-samanic-scouting-report-about-the-rising-croatian-prospect/ |publisher=BasketUniverso |accessdate=31 August 2018 |date=22 January 2018}} His father Marko played basketball professionally for 19 years, including in the [[EuroLeague]] with Slovenian club [[KK Krka|Krka]].{{cite web |last1=Hein |first1=David |title=Development is priority for Barcelona talent Samanic |url=http://www.adidasngt.com/u18/news/latest/i/8gke7iov3ioav8uo/development-is-priority-for-barcelona-talent-samanic |publisher=[[Euroleague Basketball Next Generation Tournament|Adidas Next Generation Tournament]] |accessdate=31 August 2018 |date=10 January 2018}} Due to his father's career, Šamanić lived in a number of countries in his early life. When he was nine months old, he moved to Belgium, and he later stayed in Slovenia and Germany.{{cite web |title=Globe-trotter, late starter Samanic out to follow in stars’ footsteps |url=http://www.fiba.basketball/europe/u16/2016/news/globe-trotter-late-starter-samanic-out-to-follow-in-stars-footsteps |publisher=[[FIBA]] |accessdate=3 September 2018 |date=11 August 2016}} Šamanić grew up playing [[association football|football]], [[handball]], and [[tennis]], and was also involved in [[breakdancing]].{{cite web |last1=Givony |first1=Jonathan |last2=Schmitz |first2=Mike |title=2016 Adidas EuroCamp: Day Two |url=http://www.draftexpress.com/article/2016-adidas-Eurocamp-Day-Two-5555/ |publisher=DraftExpress |accessdate=1 September 2018 |date=11 June 2016}}{{cite web |last1=Hein |first1=David |title=Talented trio Pecarski, Garuba, Samanic leading the way at U16 Euros |url=http://www.fiba.basketball/news/talented-trio-pecarski-garuba-samanic-leading-the-way-at-u16-euros |publisher=[[FIBA]] |accessdate=31 August 2018 |date=18 August 2016}} He did not start playing basketball, the last sport he attempted, until he was 11 years old. Still, he credits his football experience for improving his coordination as a basketball player. == Youth career == Šamanić began his basketball career at the youth levels with local club [[KK Zagreb|Zagreb]].{{cite web |title=Defensive ace Luka Samanic voted MVP, headlines All-Star Five team |url=http://www.fiba.basketball/europe/u18b/2017/news/defensive-ace-luka-samanic-voted-mvp-headlines-all-star-five-team |publisher=[[FIBA]] |accessdate=31 August 2018 |date=6 August 2017}} He collected 29 points, 10 rebounds, 4 steals, and 3 blocks for Zagreb in a 22 November 2014 win over the junior team for Šanac Karlovac.{{cite web |title=Kadeti ponovo susped! |url=http://www.kk-zagreb.hr/?p=3949 |publisher=[[KK Zagreb]] |accessdate=31 August 2018 |language=Croatian |date=22 November 2014}} On 16 November, he recorded 43 points, 8 rebounds, and 7 steals for Zagreb to help defeat Samobor, 160–21.{{cite web |title=Kadeti postigli 160 koševa u novoj pobjedi! |url=http://www.kk-zagreb.hr/?p=5157 |publisher=[[KK Zagreb]] |accessdate=1 September 2018 |language=Croatian |date=16 November 2015}} On 3 January 2016, Šamanić led his team to a championship win against [[Pallacanestro Virtus Roma|Virtus Roma]] in a youth tournament in Italy, for which he earned [[most valuable player]] (MVP) honors.{{cite web |title=Kadeti prvi u Italiji, Luka Šamanić MVP! |url=http://www.kk-zagreb.hr/?p=5334 |publisher=[[KK Zagreb]] |accessdate=1 September 2018 |language=Croatian |date=3 January 2016}} He scored 32 points on 16 January, in a blowout 111–43 win over the Rudeš junior team.{{cite web |title=Nova pobjeda kadeta |url=http://www.kk-zagreb.hr/?p=5394 |publisher=[[KK Zagreb]] |accessdate=1 September 2018 |language=Croatian |date=16 January 2016}} Later in the month, Šamanić dominated versus the [[KK Cedevita|Cedevita]] junior team, notching 26 points, 10 rebounds, 4 steals, and 4 blocks.{{cite web |title=Kadeti uvjerljivi protiv Cedevite |url=http://www.kk-zagreb.hr/?p=5500 |publisher=[[KK Zagreb]] |accessdate=1 September 2018 |language=Croatian |date=25 January 2016}} He continued his success on 22 February, when he erupted for 39 points and 21 rebounds in a 160–50 win over the junior team for Sisak.{{cite web |title=Kadeti protiv Siska slavili sa 110 razlike |url=http://www.kk-zagreb.hr/?p=5656 |publisher=[[KK Zagreb]] |accessdate=1 September 2018 |language=Croatian |date=22 February 2016}} On 29 May, Šamanić was named MVP of the Croatian cadet championship after his [[double (basketball)|double-double]] of 16 points and 11 rebounds in a blowout of [[KK Cibona|Cibona]] junior squad.{{cite web |title=Kadeti Zagreba prvaci Hrvatske! |url=http://www.kk-zagreb.hr/?p=6073 |publisher=[[KK Zagreb]] |accessdate=1 September 2018 |language=Croatian |date=29 May 2016}} In June, he attended the [[Adidas]] EuroCamp, a three-day pre-[[National Basketball Association]] (NBA) [[NBA draft|draft]] camp for international prospects held in [[Treviso]], Italy.{{cite web |title=adidas Eurocamp Announces 2016 Player Roster |url=https://news.adidas.com/us/Latest-News/adidas-eurocamp-announces-2016-player-roster/s/1689ad8b-ec1e-43c0-ab56-d42aad370b68 |publisher=[[Adidas]] |accessdate=15 September 2016 |date=8 June 2016}} On 14 June 2016, Šamanić signed a 2-year amateur contract with Spanish club [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|FC Barcelona]], initially joining its junior ranks.{{cite web |title=Luka Samanic, al Barça: croata de 15 años y 2.08 m. Así juega la sensación en Treviso |url=http://www.gigantes.com/cantera/luka-samanic-al-barca-croata-de-15-anos-y-2-08-m-asi-juega-la-sensacion-en-treviso-video/ |publisher=Gigantes del Basket |accessdate=1 September 2018 |language=Spanish |date=14 June 2016}}{{cite web |title=El Barça Lassa B ya trabaja en la Ciutat Esportiva |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.es/secciones/baloncesto/fc-barcelona-b/noticias/2016-2017/el-barca-lassa-b-ya-trabaja-en-la-ciudad-esportiva |publisher=[[FC Barcelona]] |accessdate=3 September 2018 |language=Spanish |date=17 August 2016}} On 22 December, he won the [[slam dunk|Slam Dunk]] Contest at a youth tournament in [[Tenerife]].{{cite web |title=Así se llevó Luka Samanic el concurso de mates del Torneo Junior Tenerife |url=http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=128235 |publisher=[[Liga ACB]] |accessdate=1 September 2018 |language=Spanish |date=22 December 2016}} In January 2017, Šamanić played with Barcelona's junior team at the Ciutat de L'Hospitalet qualifiers for the [[2016–17 Euroleague Basketball Next Generation Tournament|2016–17 Adidas Next Generation Tournament]] and was one year younger than most of his opponents at both events.{{cite web |title=L' Hospitalitet champions: Barca far the best, few interesting names emerged |url=http://www.doubledouble.rs/en/in-focus/l-hospitalitet-champions-barca-far-the-best-few-interesting-names-emerged/ |publisher=DoubleDouble |accessdate=3 September 2018 |date=9 January 2017}}{{cite web |title=ANGT MVP Fevrier of Paris headlines All-Tournament Team |url=http://www.adidasngt.com/u18/news/latest/i/7tq4fg39g34kcdfy/angt-mvp-fevrier-of-paris-headlines-all-tournament-team |publisher=[[Euroleague Basketball Next Generation Tournament|Adidas Next Generation Tournament]] |accessdate=3 September 2018|date=21 May 2017}} In his first game at the qualifiers, on 6 January, he recorded 11 points and 5 rebounds in a 79–56 win over the [[KK Olimpija|Olimpija]] junior team.{{cite web |title=Jan 6, 2017: Union Olimpija Junior Team 56, FC Barcelona Regal Junior Team 79 |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/international/boxscore/2017-01-06/Union-Olimpija-Junior-Team-at-FC-Barcelona-Regal-Junior-Team/259093 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |accessdate=3 September 2018 |date=6 January 2017}} In the final tournament in May, Šamanić averaged 8.7 points, 6 rebounds, and 0.7 assists through 3 games, earning the Rising Star Trophy.{{cite web |title=Luka Samanic Player Profile |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/player/Luka-Samanic/Summary/94639 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |accessdate=3 September 2018}} Later that month, he won the Slam Dunk Contest at the EuroLeague FanZone, a three-day entertainment event at the [[2017 EuroLeague Final Four]].{{cite web |title=Three days of non-stop activities at the FanZone in Marmara Forum! |url=http://www.euroleague.net/final-four/istanbul-2017/fanzone |publisher=[[EuroLeague]] |accessdate=3 September 2018}}{{cite web |last1=Fernández |first1=Marcos |title=El blaugrana Samanic, campeón del concurso de mates del Adidas Next Generation |url=http://www.gigantes.com/cantera/competiciones-torneos-y-campeonatos/el-blaugrana-simanic-campeon-del-concurso-de-mates-del-adidas-next-generation-video/ |publisher=Gigantes del Basket |language=Spanish |accessdate=3 September 2018 |date=21 May 2017}} By August 2017, Šamanić was drawing attention from several [[NCAA Division I]] programs, including [[Florida Gators men's basketball|Florida]], [[Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball|Gonzaga]], and [[Purdue Boilermakers men's basketball|Purdue]].{{cite web |last1=Daniels |first1=Evan |title=FIBA u18: College an option for Luka Samanic |url=https://247sports.com/college/basketball/recruiting/Article/FIBA-u18-College-an-option-for-Croatia-native-Luka-Samanic--105712290/ |publisher=[[247Sports.com|247Sports]] |accessdate=21 September 2018 |date=2 August 2017}} In the 2017–18 season with Barcelona's junior team, he assumed a greater role after many of its top players left. In January 2018, Šamanić joined Barcelona at the Ciutat de L'Hospitalet qualifiers for the [[2017–18 Euroleague Basketball Next Generation Tournament|2017–18 Adidas Next Generation Tournament]]. He posted 27 points, 16 rebounds, and 3 blocks on 7 January, as his team lost to the [[Club Joventut Badalona|Joventut Badalona]] junior team in the championship.{{cite web |last1=Stankovic |first1=Vladimir |title=Los 10 cracks del Torneo de L’Hospitalet |url=https://www.mundodeportivo.com/baloncesto/20180108/434169465795/samanic-lidera-una-buena-cosecha.html |website=[[Mundo Deportivo]] |accessdate=21 September 2018 |language=Spanish |date=8 January 2018}} Still, Šamanić was named L'Hospitalet tournament MVP and earned All-Tournament Team honors after averaging 23.2 points, 14.8 rebounds, 3 assists, and 2.8 blocks through 4 games.{{cite web |title=Barcelona's Samanic named ANGT L'Hospitalet MVP |url=http://www.adidasngt.com/u18/news/latest/i/8gdb4omnc5us683e/barcelona-s-samanic-named-angt-l-hospitalet-mvp |publisher=[[Euroleague Basketball Next Generation Tournament]] |accessdate=21 September 2018 |date=7 January 2018}} == Professional career == === FC Barcelona B (2017–2018) === In the [[2017–18 LEB Oro season|2017–18 season]], Šamanić competed for [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet B]]—the [[reserve team]] of FC Barcelona—in the [[Liga Española de Baloncesto|LEB Oro]], the [[Spanish basketball league system|second-tier Spanish league]].{{cite web |title=Luka Samanic Game Logs |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/player/Luka-Samanic/GameLogs/94639/International/2018/55 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |accessdate=15 September 2018}} He debuted on 1 October 2017, in a 76–69 win over [[Força Lleida CE|Força Lleida]], playing only 4 minutes.{{cite web |title=Oct 1, 2017: Actel Forca Lleida 69, FC Barcelona II 76 |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/international/boxscore/2017-10-01/Actel-Forca-Lleida-at-FC-Barcelona-II/271930 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |accessdate=15 September 2018 |date=1 October 2017}} Šamanić stood out in his next game versus [[Cáceres Ciudad del Baloncesto|Cáceres]], scoring 10 points in 20 minutes and performing a [[slam dunk#windmill|windmill dunk]].{{cite web |last1=Fernández |first1=Marcos |title=El blaugrana Luka Samanic da espectáculo en LEB: matazo ‘molinillo’ ante Cáceres |url=http://www.gigantes.com/cantera/jovenes-promesas/el-blaugrana-luka-samanic-da-espectaculo-en-leb-matazo-molinillo-ante-caceres-video/ |publisher=Gigantes del Basket |accessdate=15 September 2018 |language=Spanish |date=7 October 2017}} On 4 November 2017, he scored 11 points in 19 minutes against [[Araberri BC|Araberri]].{{cite web |title=Nov 4, 2017: FC Barcelona II 68, Saenz Horeca Araberri |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/international/boxscore/2017-11-04/FC-Barcelona-II-at-Saenz-Horeca-Araberri/288316 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |accessdate=15 September 2018 |date=4 November 2017}} In his following appearance, Šamanić collected 10 points and 8 rebounds in a win over [[CB Peñas Huesca|Peñas Huesca]].{{cite web |last1=Fernández |first1=Marcos |title=Competiciones FEB en clave Junior (8). Mira los Sub-20 más destacados de la semana |url=http://www.gigantes.com/cantera/competiciones-torneos-y-campeonatos/competiciones-feb-clave-junior-8-mira-los-sub-20-mas-destacados-la-semana/ |publisher=Gigantes del Basket |accessdate=15 September 2018 |language=Spanish |date=20 November 2017}} He scored a season-high 17 points on 9 February 2018, leading his team past [[Palencia Baloncesto|Palencia]].{{cite web |title=Feb 9, 2018: FC Barcelona II 64, Quesos Cerrato de Palencia 62 |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/international/boxscore/2018-02-09/FC-Barcelona-II-at-Quesos-Cerrato-de-Palencia/294569 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |accessdate=15 September 2018 |date=9 February 2018}} Through 22 games, Šamanić averaged 5.1 points, 2 rebounds, and 0.7 assists in 12.7 minutes per game. In February 2018, he took part in a [[Basketball Without Borders]] camp in [[Los Angeles]], joining several other international NBA prospects.{{cite web |last1=Givony |first1=Jonathan |title=Basketball Without Borders: Camp preview and full roster reveal |url=http://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/22360171/2018-basketball-borders-preview-full-rosters-nba-draft |publisher=[[ESPN]] |accessdate=21 September 2018 |date=8 February 2018}} === Olimpija (2018–present) === On 31 May 2018, Šamanić signed a multi-year professional contract with [[KK Olimpija|Petrol Olimpija]] of the [[Premier A Slovenian Basketball League|Slovenian League]] and [[ABA League]].{{cite web |title=Luka Šamanić prva okrepitev po koncu sezone |url=http://www.petrol.olimpija.com/novice/luka-amanic-prva-okrepitev-po-koncu-sezone |publisher=[[KK Olimpija]] |accessdate=10 September 2018 |language=Slovenian |date=31 May 2018}} He joined Olimpija after failing to agree to terms with Croatian club [[KK Zadar|Zadar]].{{cite web |title=Šamanić napustio Barcelonu |url=https://basketball.hr/vijesti/video-samanic-napustio-barcelonu/5232 |publisher=Basketball.hr |accessdate=10 September 2018 |language=Croatian |date=22 May 2018}} Šamanić debuted for Olimpija on 21 September in an 86–60 loss to [[KK Crvena zvezda|Crvena zvezda]] at the [[2018 ABA League Supercup]], recording 2 points and 3 rebounds in 19 minutes.{{cite web |title=CZV - OLI |url=https://www.aba-liga.com/match.php?id=4&sez=18&lea=3&tab=Boxscore&q=q1 |publisher=[[ABA League]] |accessdate=22 September 2018 |date=21 September 2018}} On 7 May 2019, he recorded season-high marks of 22 points and 11 rebounds in an 85–73 win over [[KK Šenčur|Šenčur]] in the Slovenian League.{{cite web |title=May 7, 2019 - Sencur Gorenjska Gradbena Druzba Kranj 73 at Union Olimpija 85 |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/international/boxscore/2019-05-07/Sencur-Gorenjska-Gradbena-Druzba-Kranj-at-Union-Olimpija/334007 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |accessdate=16 May 2019 |date=7 May 2019}} On 20 April 2019, Šamanić declared his entry into the [[2019 NBA Draft]].{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/DraftExpress/status/1119633495117185026|title=6'11 Croatian forward Luka Samanic has entered the 2019 NBA draft, a source told ESPN. The 19-year old is ranked #39 on the ESPN 100 and will likely get looks in the first round.|first=Jonathan|last=Givony|date=April 20, 2019|website=Twitter.com|access-date=April 25, 2019}} He became one of a record-high 58 international prospects to declare entry that year.{{cite web |last1=Givony |first1=Jonathan |title=NBA draft: 233 early-entry prospects declare for 2019 |url=http://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/26586762/nba-draft-233-early-entry-prospects-declare-2019 |publisher=[[ESPN]] |accessdate=April 26, 2019 |date=April 23, 2019}} Šamanić later entered the 2019 [[NBA Draft Combine]] as one of 77 total participants.[https://www.nba.com/article/2019/05/08/66-players-attend-nba-draft-combine Sixty-six players expected to attend NBA Draft Combine] == National team career == Šamanić represents [[Croatia men's national basketball team|Croatia]] in [[FIBA]] competition. He made his national team debut at the [[2016 FIBA Europe Under-16 Championship]] in [[Radom]], Poland. On 16 August 2016, Šamanić recorded 17 points, 15 rebounds, 5 assists, and 9 blocks in a 74–67 victory over Sweden.{{cite web |title=Aug 16, 2016: Sweden 67, Croatia 74 |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/national/boxscore/2016-08-16/Sweden-at-Croatia/239424 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |accessdate=4 September 2018 |date=16 August 2016}} In his final game at the event, he posted 24 points and 12 rebounds, shooting 4-of-9 from the three-point line, in a loss to [[Turkey men's national under-16 and under-17 basketball team|Turkey]].{{cite web |title=Aug 20, 2016: Croatia 70, Turkey 77 |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/national/boxscore/2016-08-20/Croatia-at-Turkey/239432 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |accessdate=4 September 2018 |date=20 August 2016}} As Croatia finished in fourth place, Šamanić averaged 17.7 points, 10.4 rebounds, and 2.9 blocks per game, earning All-Star Five honors.{{cite web |title=Usman Garuba claims MVP award to lead All-Star Five |url=http://www.fiba.basketball/europe/u16/2016/news/usman-garuba-claims-mvp-award-to-lead-all-star-five |publisher=[[FIBA]] |accessdate=4 September 2018 |date=21 August 2016}} In 2017, he played at the [[FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship#Division B|FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship Division B]] in [[Tallinn]], Estonia.{{cite web |title=Players to Watch at the FIBA U18 European Championship 2017 Division B |url=http://www.heinnews.com/basketball/international-basketball/fiba-basketball/players-to-watch-at-the-fiba-u18-european-championship-2017-division-b/ |publisher=heinnews |accessdate=20 September 2018 |date=28 July 2017}} Šamanić led Croatia to a [[gold medal]] after recording 21 points, 8 rebounds, 4 steals, and 3 blocks in an overtime win over Great Britain.{{cite web |title=Croatia take home gold after overtime drama, Estonia finish on the podium |url=http://www.fiba.basketball/europe/u18b/2017/news/croatia-take-home-gold-after-overtime-drama-estonia-finish-on-the-podium |publisher=[[FIBA]] |accessdate=20 September 2018 |date=6 August 2017}} He was named tournament MVP and made the All-Star Five after averaging 13.3 points, 7.3 rebounds, 1.8 steals, and 1.6 blocks per game. Šamanić took part in the [[2018 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]] in [[Latvia]].{{cite web |title=Amid lofty expectations, Samanic has high hopes for Croatia |url=http://www.fiba.basketball/europe/u18/2018/news/amid-lofty-expectations-samanic-has-high-hopes-for-croatia |publisher=[[FIBA]] |accessdate=4 September 2018 |date=31 July 2018}} On 3 August 2018, he notched 29 points, 10 rebounds, and 4 blocks, shooting 5-of-5 from the three-point line, to help defeat Ukraine.{{cite web |title=Aug 3, 2018: Ukraine 62, Croatia 85 |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/national/boxscore/2018-08-03/Ukraine-at-Croatia/307700 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |accessdate=20 September 2018 |date=3 August 2018}} Even though Šamanić averaged 17 points, 7.7 rebounds, and 1.8 blocks per game in the tournament, Croatia finished in 11th place. == Personal life == Šamanić often takes advice from his father Marko Šamanić, a former professional basketball player, before and after games and tournaments. He admires and emulates [[Toni Kukoč]], a Croatian basketball star who saw great success in the NBA and European leagues.{{cite web |last1=Smith |first1=Sam |title=Toni Kukoc Always Delivered |url=http://history.bulls.com/toni-kukoc-always-delivered/ |publisher=[[Chicago Bulls]] |accessdate=15 September 2018 |date=27 December 2017}} Šamanić has also compared his playing style to NBA players [[Kristaps Porziņģis]] and [[Kevin Durant]].{{cite web |last1=Radičević |first1=Vlado |title=Hrvatski tinejdžer potpuno zaludio NBA skaute; ovako nešto dugo nije viđeno! |url=https://www.tportal.hr/sport/clanak/hrvatski-tinejdzer-potpuno-zaludio-nba-skaute-ovako-nesto-dugo-nije-videno-20180109 |publisher=tportal |accessdate=21 September 2018 |language=Croatian |date=9 January 2018}} Off of the basketball court, he likes to play football and [[table tennis]]. == References == {{Reflist}} ==External links== * [http://basketball.eurobasket.com/player/Luka-Samanic/Spain/FC-Barcelona-Lassa/368795 Eurobasket.com profile] * [http://www.nbadraft.net/players/luka-samanic NBADraft.net Profile] * [https://basketball.realgm.com/player/Luka-Samanic/Summary/94639 REALGM Profile] {{KK Olimpija current roster}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Samanic, Luka}} [[Category:2000 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:ABA League players]] [[Category:Croatian expatriate basketball people in Spain]] [[Category:Croatian men's basketball players]] [[Category:FC Barcelona Bàsquet B players]] [[Category:KK Olimpija players]] [[Category:Small forwards]] [[Category:Power forwards (basketball)]] [[Category:Sportspeople from Zagreb]]
